subject.title: fix(agents): guard stuck-session recovery with run-handle identity

question: Should captured run-handle identity be exposed as an additive plugin-SDK API, or remain private to embedded-run recovery?
rationale: The branch updates the committed plugin-SDK baseline for an internal recovery mechanism; compatibility and long-term API ownership require maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep the API private
options.body: Use a private identity-aware helper for abort-and-drain recovery and retain the existing exported function signatures.

options.title: Adopt the SDK addition
options.body: Accept the new optional handle parameters as a supported plugin contract and add explicit compatibility documentation and focused contract coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep the API private
recommendation.body: Use a private identity-aware helper for abort-and-drain recovery and retain the existing exported function signatures.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete diagnosis and existing-pattern comparison for the affected recovery path, though repository ownership evidence is limited.
